name: Shard of My Soul
source:
Kathleen is 19 years old. She has an older sister, Viola. Several months ago, Viola disappeared, without a word, without a trace. No one has heard from her since. Kathleen is almost over it, but tomorrow is Kathleen's first day at the college. And coincidentally the same college that her sister attended. Now it's up to Kathleen. She must navigate her first college year ‒ she'll study, meet new people, have some fun and make new friends (or maybe more than friends). But could she really find happiness while her sister is still missing? Will she find out what happened to her? Which path will Kat's life take? It's all in your hands...

[From [url=https://iridescenttaste.itch.io/shard-of-my-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
